purpose: P1 read-only QDC device acceptance probe
run_id_source: generated locally before session; no secrets
expected_transport: select from the actual QDC Connect dialog
minimum_checks: manual Connect dialog interpretation and read-only remote command execution
verified upload and download transfer with SHA256 and measured throughput
read-only inventory of known Voice AI SDK paths, VAD library, and existing ASR model files
runtime and shell tools, including any existing C++ compiler
five-second --help smoke for preinstalled QNN/GenieX/llama.cpp CLI tools, when timeout is present
execute the bundled static ARM64 ABI smoke on aarch64; compile its source only when a compiler is already present
non-root permissions and QDC log backup availability

schedule_minutes.phase: small bundle upload and return-file transfer check
bundled static ARM64 smoke (native compile when available)
compatibility decisions and immediate result collection

stop_conditions: stop at 4 minutes if transport or target identity remains unresolved
stop immediately if any action requests root, flashes, reboots, or modifies system state
stop optional experiments at minute 21 and reserve at least 5 minutes for collection
skip the ARM64 smoke only if the target is not aarch64 or the verified prebuilt is missing; do not install a compiler
do not install SDKs, download models, or build inference packages on the device in the first session
